introduction.report: The report describes flooding during ordinary rain, even after the drain entrance was cleaned twice.
introduction.focus: Possible explanations being compared: Drain blockage; Insufficient drainage capacity.

introduction.report: The report describes waste repeatedly appearing beside a collection point that can be reached by collection crews.
introduction.focus: The investigation checks collection records and site observations to understand why waste is building up.

introduction.report: The report describes waste overflowing on market days, although the collection schedule says pickups should happen daily.
introduction.focus: Possible explanations being compared: Solid Waste Container Capacity Shortfall; Missed Municipal Collection Cycle.

introduction.report: The report says road damage returned after two repairs. It also mentions a pipe beneath the road, but does not establish that it is leaking.
introduction.focus: The investigation checks the road, the ground beneath it and relevant utility evidence to understand the damage.
